 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Getting the famous star-spangled Champions League ball rolling on Matchday 3, Borussia Dortmund have travelled to Azerbaijan to take on Sabah FC from 18:45 CET this evening.
 With kick-off at the Olympic Stadium about to happen in a little over an hour's time, here are the confirmed lineups for both teams as selected by their respective coaches.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Confirmed Sabah vs. Borussia Dortmund lineups:
 Sabah (4-3-2-1): Pokatilov – Zedadka, McCarthy, Solvet, Puchacz – Lepinjica, Rakhmonaliev, Du Queiroz – Parris, Simić – Mickels
 Borussia Dortmund (3-4-1-2): Kobel – Anton, Schlotterbeck, Bensebaini – Ryerson, Veerman, Nmecha, Svensson – Chukwuemeka – Silva, Guirassy
